t: The Essentials Varennes outdoor LED solar wall light is a traditional wall-mounted fixture designed to provide reliable exterior illumination. This solar-powered unit is ideal for homeowners looking to enhance security and visibility around front entrances, driveways and garden patios. Featuring a durable black aluminium body and a robust plastic diffuser, the light delivers a bright 500 lumen cool white glow. An integrated 90° PIR motion sensor detects movement up to 5m away to instantly illuminate dark pathways, while the IP44 rating ensures dependable weather protection.
